name: fe_akg_radical_halogenase
description: Fe(II)/alpha-ketoglutarate-dependent radical halogenase. Anchor: the 2-His pair on adjacent beta-strands of the cupin double-stranded beta-helix that chelates Fe(II) in every member of the superfamily. Discriminator: the ABSENCE of the canonical Asp/Glu third ligand (the 2His-1Asp/Glu facial triad), which leaves the open coordination site that halide must occupy for halide transfer. Reproduces Kipouros & Chang, Nature 656, 763 (2026).
